name: Coffee Scrubs 14 oz Tumbler with Lid
seoTitle: Coffee Scrubs Tumbler with Lid for Nurses
metaDescription: A 14 oz Coffee Scrubs tumbler with a lid from Brooke and Jess Designs, a cute Nurses Week gift for RNs, CNAs, LPNs, and nursing students who run on coffee.
summary: A lidded 14 oz tumbler with a coffee and scrubs theme, a fun pick for Nurses Week or for any nurse, CNA, or student who brings coffee to every shift.
whyItWorks: Coffee and scrubs are two things almost every nurse puts on before a shift, and a tumbler that names both feels like it was made for their mornings. The pairing is simple and cheerful, the kind of design that makes someone smile when they grab it from the car on the way into work.

A lid is a big deal in healthcare. Open cups are often not allowed at the nurses station, and a lidded tumbler is less likely to spill when it gets set down quickly during a busy stretch. The 14 ounce size holds a good amount of coffee without being bulky, which helps when counter space is tight. Since the title mentions RNs, CNAs, LPNs, nursing students, and even doctors, it is an easy choice for unit wide Nurses Week gifts or for a coworker whose exact role you are unsure about. Fill it with a few coffee pods or a gift card to their favorite cafe.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for whether it is insulated and how the lid closes.
Look at the listing for care instructions, since printed tumblers often need hand washing.
Many units only allow lidded drinks at the station, so the lid is a practical plus.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a CNA?
faq.a: Yes, the title lists CNAs among the recipients and the coffee and scrubs theme fits anyone who works in scrubs.

faq.q: Will it keep coffee hot through a shift?
faq.a: The title does not say whether it is insulated, so check the listing for that detail before buying for a nurse who needs coffee to stay warm.
